value.rationale: Risk aversion is not a peripheral parameter: the motivating work explicitly introduces mean–variance utility and devotes Figures 6–7, Section 4.2 and a principal conclusion to risk-sensitive trajectories and policy behavior. In the supplied final dynamic and discrete formulas, even complete noiseless trajectories and complete stochastic path laws contain zero information about lambda. The exact positive value 729/6400 at calibrated fine rates shows the missing sensitivity is economically real in the specified payoff game rather than an algebraic cancellation. This gives a decisive model-vs-claim boundary useful for reproducibility, empirical calibration, and interpretation, without imputing undocumented simulation behavior.
